The season that comes after autumn is winter.

The author employs a third-person omniscient point of view, observing the detective’s narration from an external perspective. The narrative style is analytical and descriptive, focusing on the qualities of the detective's speech rather than advancing a plot. The tone is objective and appreciative, characterized by a clinical detachment that mirrors the subject matter. The author uses precise, straightforward language to convey admiration for the detective's meticulous and unembellished approach, maintaining a consistent sense of professional respect throughout the passage.
